// The 20 evaluation queries (same order as the scoring sheet).
// Each query gets its own session so earlier answers cannot influence later ones.
const QUERIES = [
  { id: 1, lang: "EN", query: "How do I register as OKU in Malaysia?" },
  { id: 2, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah kategori OKU yang diiktiraf oleh JKM?" },
  { id: 3, lang: "EN", query: "What is the definition of OKU under the Persons with Disabilities Act 2008?" },
  { id: 4, lang: "BM", query: "Siapa yang layak menerima Elaun Pekerja OKU (EPOKU)?" },
  { id: 5, lang: "EN", query: "What is Bantuan OKU Tidak Berupaya Bekerja (BTB) and who can apply?" },
  { id: 6, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah program Job Coach?" },
  { id: 7, lang: "EN", query: "What training does Bengkel Daya offer to OKU?" },
  { id: 8, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah Bantuan Alat Sokongan (BAT) dan bagaimana cara memohon?" },
  { id: 9, lang: "EN", query: "What help is available for caregivers of bedridden OKU?" },
  { id: 10, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah Pusat Kehidupan Berdikari (ILC)?" },
  { id: 11, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah pilihan pendidikan khas untuk kanak-kanak OKU?" },
  { id: 12, lang: "EN", query: "What is the PERKESO Invalidity Pension and what is the minimum monthly amount?" },
  { id: 13, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah dokumen yang diperlukan untuk menuntut Pencen Ilat PERKESO?" },
  { id: 14, lang: "EN", query: "What public transport facilities are available for OKU?" },
  { id: 15, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah pelepasan cukai yang disediakan untuk OKU?" },
  { id: 16, lang: "EN", query: "I am an OKU who is working. What financial help can I get?" },
  { id: 17, lang: "EN", query: "How many OKU in Selangor received EPOKU this year?" },
  { id: 18, lang: "BM", query: "Berapakah elaun Bajet 2027 untuk pelajar OKU?" },
  { id: 19, lang: "EN", query: "How do I renew my passport?" },
  { id: 20, lang: "BM", query: "Apakah resepi nasi lemak yang sedap?" }
];
const run = Date.now().toString(36);
return QUERIES.map((q) => ({ json: { ...q, session_id: `eval-${run}-${q.id}`, started_at: Date.now() } }));
